description: This file defines the EmployeesStudioModule class, which extends StudioModule. It customizes subpanel provisioning and module relationships behavior in the SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: EmployeesStudioModule
classes.description: A class extending StudioModule to customize module behavior related to employees, specifically in relation to subpanels and relationships.

methods.name: getProvidedSubpanels
methods.description: Returns false, indicating that employees should not have related subpanels.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Overrides parent method to exclude the 'Relationships' entry from the list of modules.
